criteria.text: Rename, interface change, rebase, squash, force update, deletion, and branch switch cases use actual snapshots and ancestry to reassess affected obligations.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: Knowledge and derivatives remain bound to the approved branch snapshot; feature-branch content cannot silently become another branch's current knowledge.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: A commit observed or assessed cannot advance full reconciliation while integration, required products, ownership, or recovery remains unresolved.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

requirements.title: Prevent duplicates and self-trigger loops
requirements.outcome: Recognize repeated deliveries and already satisfied work using operation identity, hashes, versions, and causal provenance without suppressing all Curator-originated changes.

criteria.text: Duplicate, retried, and out-of-order events cause one logical maintenance outcome and do not duplicate Tasks, lessons, or canonical assertions.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: A Curator code repair receives necessary documentation/knowledge follow-through; its derivative-only follow-up does not restart the satisfied repair.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: Unchanged output/failure and configured iteration or resource limits stop further expansion while retaining the unresolved finding.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

requirements.title: Provide an inactive portable scheduling capability
requirements.outcome: Supply platform-independent scheduling policy and a separate macOS per-checkout host adapter with explicit installation, readiness, relocation, and unavailable-volume behavior.

criteria.text: The reusable policy validates selected project/branch sets, debounce, catch-up and dependency cadences, bounded model/work budgets, operation entitlements, notifications, and runtime compatibility before activation.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: Neutral configuration has no live project/branch selection, installed service, active schedule, or autonomous-write entitlement; required operating selections are reported as missing rather than guessed.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: Disposable adapter checks distinguish idle, pending, unavailable, blocked, and ready; detached input cannot imply deletion, relocation preserves identity checks, and the existing Template watcher remains independent.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

requirements.title: Coordinate concurrent owners and isolated integration
requirements.outcome: Preserve one canonical coordination location and publication owner per logical project/branch while executing scoped changes in an isolated workspace.

criteria.text: Concurrent worktrees do not create competing writable Task ledgers; overlapping Director/Curator scopes wait or reconcile through their current owners, including paused or uncertain owners.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: Dirty user working trees, staged content, unrelated files, and later human edits survive; no automatic stash, reset, clean, or blind integration is used to gain access.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: Overlapping current work is coordinated before edits. Dirty, staged and unrelated files remain preserved.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

requirements.title: Use owned memory and ontology publication
requirements.outcome: Make separate evidence-based decisions for memory, ontology, and derived-only maintenance and use their existing lifecycle and publication helpers.

criteria.text: A change may justify neither, either, or both kinds of canonical knowledge; a commit or passed validator alone cannot establish truth or acceptance.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: A stale derivative alone triggers its owning maintenance operation without fabricating a new memory lesson or ontology assertion.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: Knowledge changes use the existing owner operations. Derived-only updates remain separate from source changes.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

requirements.title: Preserve knowledge history and identity
requirements.outcome: Retain source provenance, applicability, uncertainty, temporal meaning, and replacement relationships when knowledge changes.

criteria.text: Manual correction and automatic upkeep use appropriate supersession, retraction, deprecation, or replacement while preserving the earlier record's meaning and stable identity relationships.
criteria.limitation: Task-level source and ordinary evidence is partial; no full retained acceptance is inferred.

criteria.text: Authored, inferred, externally sourced, and derived material remain distinguishable; historical evidence is not retroactively rewritten to claim new results.

criteria.text: Preserve knowledge history and stable record identities.

criteria.text: A failed required rebuild remains pending even when a note or assertion was saved; disabled optional profiles are not installed or activated to make status appear current.

criteria.text: Structural, SHACL, relationship, or schema conformance is reported separately from factual truth; an inference cannot silently become an approved authored assertion.

criteria.text: Unresolved meaning is not repaired by broad speculative edits, erased history, or weakened validators.

criteria.text: AGENTS.md, a README, a generated wiki page, and a completed Task response receive different update routes independent of their extension.
